title: executing-integration-tests input
description: ENFORCED — the engine validates this ASSEMBLED stage input against this schema BEFORE the stage runs (engine/validation.py validate_stage_input; fail-closed, engine/config/runtime-binding.yaml input_validation: enforce). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage integration-tests.

files_generated.description: Shape: implement-frontend-feature schemas/output.json#/properties/files_generated. FLAT-MERGE COLLISION: also picked from backend-implement; engine keeps the LAST writer (frontend-implement). Load every producer's value via upstream_artifacts.

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key, injected into every stage payload.

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: map of producer stage id to its artifact path relative to this stage's dir.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run after a loop_back.

integration_test_context.description: Optional workflow-supplied runner context: {suite_ref, target_env, runner_profile_ref, teardown_probe_ref - non-secret refs}. Absent in replay; in live runner mode its absence stops the stage with needs-input - file manifests do not identify a runnable SIT environment.
